recent_changes.title: Indiana HBM packaging project breaks ground
recent_changes.what_changed: SK hynix reports an August 27 groundbreaking for its Indiana advanced-packaging facility. It targets mass production in the second half of 2029.
recent_changes.significance: The project would add U.S. packaging and testing capacity for high-bandwidth memory used in AI systems, using wafers made in Korea.
recent_changes.scope: Groundbreaking is a reported milestone; production remains a company target. This is packaging and testing, not U.S. wafer fabrication. The company's approximately 1,000 operating positions are projected, not verified hires.
recent_changes.rationale: Owner authorized commit and push after reviewing the three source-checked cards in RECENT_DEVELOPMENTS_REVIEW-2026-09-07.md. Preserve disclosure-date caveats and distinguish reported milestones from targets.

recent_changes.title: Meta reports its first skilled-trades training graduates
recent_changes.what_changed: Meta's August 18 update reports the first graduating cohort of America's Workforce Academy, a four-week program offering training and jobs with its partners.
recent_changes.significance: Fiber-technician and construction training provide a concrete pathway into the workforce building data centers.
recent_changes.scope: This is a company-reported graduation milestone and job guarantee, not a verified placement count or a measure of net national job creation. The release says graduation occurred the preceding week; it does not establish an exact graduation date.
recent_changes.rationale: Owner authorized commit and push after reviewing the three source-checked cards in RECENT_DEVELOPMENTS_REVIEW-2026-09-07.md. Preserve disclosure-date caveats and distinguish reported milestones from targets.

recent_changes.title: Cape Station reports progress toward first power
recent_changes.what_changed: In its August 12 update, Fervo reports mechanical completion of Cape Station GeoBlocks 1 and 2 and continuing commissioning. It targets first power from GeoBlock 1 in the fourth quarter of 2026, followed by initial power from GeoBlocks 2 and 3 in early 2027.
recent_changes.significance: Commissioning provides a nearer-term delivery checkpoint for new firm geothermal power.
recent_changes.scope: These are company-reported construction and commissioning milestones, not confirmation of commercial generation. The update covers the quarter ended June 30 and subsequent outlook; August 12 is the disclosure date, not an inferred completion date.
recent_changes.rationale: Owner authorized commit and push after reviewing the three source-checked cards in RECENT_DEVELOPMENTS_REVIEW-2026-09-07.md. Preserve disclosure-date caveats and distinguish reported milestones from targets.
